prompt:
You are a hardware-debug reviewer. A first debug agent diagnosed an RISC-V RTL failure and an explain.png diagram was drawn from that diagnosis (explain.png sha256 first 16 hex: 112b59eea0d258f6).
Case: picorv32-fetch-misalign
Failing trace window (same window the first diagnosis saw):
- tb_picorv32_fetch seed 43
- 256-word NOP mem, checking fetch alignment + trap + progress
tohost: FAIL 0xdead
TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero
CYCLES=2009
- /home/tuncay/afterglow/sim/tb/picorv32-fetch_tb.sv:91: Verilog $finish
- S i m u l a t i o n   R e p o r t: Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05
- Verilator: $finish at 20us; walltime 0.001 s; speed 33.016 ms/s
- Verilator: cpu 0.001 s on 1 threads; allocated 4 MB
First diagnosis (verbatim):
Failing signal is mem_la_addr whose low bits are 2'b10 (nonzero), triggering `TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero` instead of word-aligned 2'b00. Expected fetch/data address low bits 2'b00 for 32-bit word bus. Root cause in picorv32.v:382 which forces `{...,2'b10}` in both fetch and data arms of mem_la_addr.
First patch_diff:
diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -382,1 +382,1 @@
-\tassign mem_la_addr = (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst) ? {next_pc[31:2] + mem_la_firstword_xfer, 2'b10} : {reg_op1[31:2], 2'b10};
+\tassign mem_la_addr = (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst) ? {next_pc[31:2] + mem_la_firstword_xfer, 2'b00} : {reg_op1[31:2], 2'b00};
Look at the diagram (explain.png in the run bundle) together with the trace above. Either CONFIRM the first diagnosis (it explains the failing signal and the diff fixes it) or REVISE it (it misnames the signal or the diff is wrong). Reply JSON ONLY with keys: decision (exactly "CONFIRM" or "REVISE"), diagnosis (final diagnosis text), patch_diff (final unified diff), reason (one sentence: why the diagram confirms or what it corrects).
